title: Relationship with sorted records
description: Best-practice rule — flags relationships that sort their related records. The sort runs whenever the relation is evaluated and can slow portals and lookups.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: A sorted relationship re-sorts on every evaluation; on large sets this is costly.
rule.remediation: Sort in the portal / list layout instead where the cost is paid once per display.
